targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "calendar_event")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.title =~ /${sleep_pattern:raw}/)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r.duration_seconds) / 3600.0}))
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "calendar_event")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.title =~ /${sleep_pattern:raw}/)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r.duration_seconds) / 3600.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "home_assistant_state" and r._field == "numeric_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /^${ha_entity:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "calendar_event")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "calendar"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "title", "end_time", "duration_seconds", "location"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "activity_event" and r._field == "duration_seconds")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.app != "")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 3600.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "activity_event" and r.bucket_type == "os.lockscreen.unlocks" and r._field == "duration_seconds")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "activity_event" and r._field == "duration_seconds")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.bucket_type != "os.lockscreen.unlocks")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
